server.perm.app_denied: You do not have the “{permission}” permission of the {app} app.
server.perm.denied.base: Your account is not allowed to {action}.

server.perm.denied.role_off: The role “{rule}” is switched off, so you cannot {action}.
server.perm.denied.role_off_group: The role “{rule}”, which you have through the group “{group}”, is switched off, so you cannot {action}.

server.perm.files_lock: Locks a file it works on read-only for everyone (administrators included), for up to a year or until the app or an administrator lifts it
server.perm.files_read: Reads the contents of the files it is opened or run on, and of the files it keeps records about
server.perm.files_write: Writes files next to the one it is run on, into a folder you choose, or as that file's new version
server.perm.mail_send: Sends email through the server's mail settings
server.perm.public_pages: Creates time-limited, PIN-protected public pages for outside participants
server.perm.schedule: Wakes up once an hour on its own and runs its own work at the minute it chooses, with nobody present (only its own actions, with only the permissions above)
server.perm.settings: Reads the settings the administrator entered for it
server.perm.sign: Signs documents with this server's signing key (the key never leaves the server)
server.perm.ui: Runs its own interface in your browser, in a sandbox filex controls
server.perm.ui_connect_blob: Its interface reads blob: addresses it created itself in your browser (a document it unpacked in memory) - such an address never leaves your browser and reaches no server
server.perm.ui_download: Its interface can save files to your computer - each time you allow it
server.perm.ui_eval: Its interface may run code it builds while it runs (unsafe-eval)
server.perm.ui_frame_package: Its interface opens pages of its own package in frames inside it - this version's pages only, each in the same sandbox and under the same rules as the interface; never another site, another app or a page of filex
server.perm.ui_net_font: While you use it, your browser loads fonts from {url}: that address sees when, and the interface can add data to those requests
server.perm.ui_net_img: While you use it, your browser loads images from {url}: that address sees when, and the interface can add data to those requests
server.perm.ui_net_media: While you use it, your browser loads audio or video from {url}: that address sees when, and the interface can add data to those requests
server.perm.ui_net_style: While you use it, your browser loads styles from {url}: that address sees when, and the interface can add data to those requests
server.perm.ui_new: Adds a new {ext} file to the New menu; it opens in this app's interface
server.perm.ui_package_fetch: Its interface reads its own package - the files of this version, nothing else
server.perm.ui_print: Its interface can print documents it hands to filex (a PDF) - each time you allow it; the print dialog can also save the PDF to your computer
server.perm.ui_viewer: Opens {kind} files in its own interface, in place of filex's preview
server.perm.thumbnail: Draws the thumbnails of {kind} files: it is handed the bytes of every such file filex draws, on every storage, one at a time
server.perm.ui_wasm_eval: Its interface may compile WebAssembly in your browser (wasm-unsafe-eval)
server.perm.users_lookup: Looks up users by name or email

server.storage.root_path_forbidden: A storage cannot be the whole of its backend. Enter a sub-folder for the path or prefix, such as fileman or data/files.
server.storage.scan_exclude_everything: “{pattern}” would exclude everything on this storage. Name what to skip instead, such as .git, *.tmp or downloads/incomplete/**.
server.storage.scan_exclude_limit: Too many patterns, or one too long: write at most {max} patterns, each at most {length} characters.
server.storage.scan_exclude_syntax: “{pattern}” cannot be used to exclude paths from scanning. Write one glob per line - * within a name, ** across folders - without “!” or “..”.
server.storage.secret_address_changed: The address changed: type {field} again. A saved password or key is only sent to the address it was saved for.
server.store.intent_expired: This install link has expired. Press Install in the store again.
server.store.intent_gone: This install link was used already, or it has expired. Press Install in the store again.
server.store.intent_incompatible: This release does not work with the filex version this server runs.
server.store.intent_invalid: The install link is not one filex can act on: something a link must carry is missing or malformed (the filex it was made for, the commit, the manifest's hash). Press Install in the store again; if it happens again, the store's links need fixing.
server.store.intent_no_build: The store offers no build of this plugin for this server.
server.store.intent_pin_mismatch: What the app's repository serves is not what the store approved ({fields}). Nothing was installed.
server.store.intent_pin_mismatch_commit: The release's tag no longer serves what the commit the store approved serves: the repository moved it ({fields}). Nothing was installed.
server.store.intent_session_unknown: This review is no longer open: it was installed or closed already, or it timed out. Open the store's install link again.
server.store.intent_signature_required: This server runs only signed plugins, and no signature of this build verifies.
server.store.intent_unknown: The store does not know this install link.
server.store.intent_used: This install link was already used on this filex.
server.store.intent_version_rollback: {installed} is installed; the link is for {link}, which is not newer. A store link installs or upgrades, never goes back.
server.store.intent_wrong_instance: This install link was made for another filex ({link}); this one is {here}. Press Install in the store again and give it this filex's address.
server.store.intent_wrong_instance_publi: This filex's FILEX_PUBLIC_URL is not an address store links can be held to (an http or https address with a host, and no user name, query or fragment), so no store link is taken until the operator fixes it.
server.store.license_key_invalid: That license key cannot be used: 4 to 512 characters, no spaces (and the server needs FILEX_SECRET_KEY to keep it).
server.store.plugins_disabled: Storage plugins are turned off on this server (FILEX_PLUGINS_DISABLED).
server.store.source_other: an upload or an address, without a store ({repo})
server.store.store_bad_answer: The store answered something filex does not take: an answer it cannot read, a redirect (a store's API is asked without following one), or a time more than a day away from this server's clock - check the server's clock.
server.store.store_connect_code_invalid: The store did not take this connection code: it is unknown, used, expired or made for another filex address. Make a new one on the store's "My instances" page for this filex.
server.store.store_connection_refused: The store refused this filex's signed request. If the store disconnected it, connect it again with a new code.
server.store.store_index_invalid: The store's catalog does not verify with the key it is trusted with, has expired, or is not one this filex reads. Nothing from it is shown.
server.store.store_invalid: That is not a store address filex talks to: a store is reached over https at a public address.
server.store.store_key_changed: This store's keys changed since it was trusted: compare the new fingerprints with what the store publishes and trust it again.
server.store.store_key_not_configured: This store is configured on the server (FILEX_APP_STORE_URLS), but it signed with a key FILEX_APP_STORE_KEYS does not list. The operator adds the key.
server.store.store_media_invalid: The store's catalog names no such icon, or its bytes are not the ones its name pins.
server.store.store_not_allowed: This server does not allow this store: FILEX_APP_STORE_URLS is set, so install links and licenses are taken only from the stores it lists (none, when it is empty), and no other store is trusted, not even on first use. The operator adds the store there.
server.store.store_not_connected: This filex is not connected to the store. An administrator connects it under Plugins, Apps, Trusted stores, Connect, with the one-time code the store's "My instances" page makes.
server.store.store_signature_invalid: The link's signature does not verify against the keys this store was trusted with. Nothing was installed.
server.store.store_source_changed: The installed version ({version}) came from {installed}; this link comes from {link}. A store link never moves an app to another store or repository, nor its license key. Remove the installed app first (that deletes its settings and what it kept), then open the link again.
server.store.store_source_changed_direct: The installed version ({version}) was installed straight from its repository ({repo}), not from a store. The paid link of {store} does not take an installed app under its license: to move to the store's paid version, remove the installed app first (that deletes its settings and what it kept), then open the link again.
server.store.store_trust_required: This store is not trusted yet: an administrator compares its key fingerprints with what the store publishes and trusts it.
server.store.store_unreachable: The store could not be reached. Try the link again in a moment.
server.store_storage.conformance: {store} ran the conformance probes of filex {filex} on the {platform} build: {passed} passed, {skipped} not declared.
server.store_storage.conformance_none: The store sent no conformance run for this build.
server.store_storage.feed_changed: The release's feed is not the one {store} reviewed: its SHA-256 changed. Nothing was installed.
server.store_storage.feed_unreachable: The release's feed could not be read, so nothing was installed: {reason}
server.store_storage.held_until_license: A paid plugin is held until the store confirms its license: it is installed, and runs nothing until then.
server.store_storage.incompatible: {name} {version} works with filex {requires}; this server runs {filex}.
server.store_storage.legacy_signature: Signed over its SHA-256 alone, the old form: accepted until filex 0.56. Install a build signed over its name, version and platform.
server.store_storage.native: {name} is a program that runs on this server with filex's own rights, outside any sandbox, and it is handed the credentials of every storage made on it. Install it only if you trust its publisher ({repo}).
server.store_storage.no_build: {store} offers no build of {name} for this server ({platform}); it has builds for {platforms}.
server.store_storage.not_installed: No storage plugin called {name} is installed here.
server.store_storage.other_platform: This server runs {platform}: that build is pinned by its SHA-256 and signed by the store, but the store ran the probes on the {checked} build.
server.store_storage.pin_mismatch: What the release's feed names ({fields}) is not what {store} approved. Nothing was installed.
server.store_storage.plugins_off: Storage plugins are turned off on this server (FILEX_PLUGINS_DISABLED), so none can be installed from a store.
server.store_storage.probed_here: filex probes every claim again when it starts the plugin here: a plugin that fails is refused, and no storage can be made on it.
server.store_storage.range_unreadable: {name} {version} names the filex versions it works with as {requires}, which this server cannot read. Nothing was installed.
server.store_storage.screen_note: A storage plugin is a program an administrator installs on the server, and it runs outside any sandbox. Ask for one and say why: an administrator decides.
server.store_storage.signature_kept: The store signed this build. This server does not require signed plugins (FILEX_PLUGIN_TRUSTED_KEYS is empty), so the signature is kept with the plugin and checked from the day trusted keys are set.
server.store_storage.signature_store_bui: Another store signed this build of {name} {version}, and it does not vouch for it through this link: it no longer lists that version, could not be asked, or signed only the build's SHA-256. Install it from the store that signed it.
server.store_storage.signature_refused: This server runs only signed plugins, and no signature of this build verifies with FILEX_PLUGIN_TRUSTED_KEYS. Add the store's artifact key there to install it.
server.store_storage.signature_verified: This server runs only signed plugins, and FILEX_PLUGIN_TRUSTED_KEYS verifies this build's signature.
server.store_storage.source_changed: {name} is installed from {installed}; this link installs it from {repo} through {store}. A store link does not move a plugin to another store or repository: remove the installed plugin first.
server.store_storage.source_changed_dire: {name} was installed from its repository ({repo}), not from a store; the paid link of {store} does not take an installed plugin under its license. Remove the installed plugin first.
server.store_storage.source_changed_othe: {name} was uploaded or installed from an address; this link installs it from {repo} through {store}. Remove the installed plugin first.
server.store_storage.source_changed_stor: {name} is installed from {installed} through {was_store}; this link installs it from {repo} through {store}. A store link does not move a plugin to another store or repository: remove the installed plugin first.
server.store_storage.unsigned: The store did not sign this build.
server.store_storage.version_rollback: {name} {installed} is installed; the link is for {version}, which is not newer. A store link installs or upgrades, never goes back.
server.token.scope_unknown: “{scope}” is not a permission this server issues (read, write, delete, mcp, admin, or root:<storage>://<folder>).
server.token.scopes_required: Choose at least one permission. “admin” grants the whole admin panel and is never included unless you choose it.

server.auth_provider.pam_hint_platform: The PAM sign-in works on Linux only, on a server that runs filex directly (not inside Docker, which has no PAM of the host).
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_pamtester_: pamtester is not installed at `{pamtester}`. Install it - Debian/Ubuntu: `sudo apt install pamtester` - Fedora/RHEL: `sudo dnf install pamtester` - then test again.
`{pamtester}` exists but filex cannot run it. Make it executable: `sudo chmod 755 {pamtester}`
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_pam_servic: There is no PAM service file `{pamfile}`. Create it with the two lines `auth required pam_unix.so` and `account required pam_unix.so` (the operating-system accounts page of the docs has variants for sssd and two-factor), then test again.
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_sudo_missi: sudo is not installed at `{sudo}`. Install it (`sudo apt install sudo`) or fix sudo_path. Running filex as root instead is not recommended.
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_sudo_passw: sudo asks for a password when {runas} runs pamtester. Allow that one command without a password: run `sudo visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/filex` and put in it the line `{runas} ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: {pamtester} {service} *`, then test again.
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_sudo_not_a: sudoers does not let {runas} run that command. Run `sudo visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/filex` and put in it the line `{runas} ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: {pamtester} {service} *`, then test again.
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_sudo_requi: sudo insists on a terminal (requiretty). In `/etc/sudoers.d/filex` add the line `Defaults:{runas} !requiretty`, then test again. That line is for classic sudo only (`sudo --version` says `Sudo version`): sudo-rs has no such setting, and its `visudo` rejects the line.
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_pam_broken: PAM answered with an error or did not answer in time, so it cannot judge sign-ins. Check `/etc/pam.d/{service}` and the system log, and try by hand: `sudo -n {pamtester} {service} nosuchuser authenticate`
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_accepts_an: PAM accepted a user that does not exist with a random password: `{pamfile}` lets everybody in. It must end in a real check such as pam_unix.so or pam_sss.so, never pam_permit.so alone.
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_getent_fai: getent could not be run, so system accounts cannot be told apart. Install it (Debian/Ubuntu: libc-bin, Fedora/RHEL: glibc-common).
server.auth_provider.pam_hint_test_accou: Give the username and password of a real account on this machine to test with. That account becomes a super administrator of filex.
PAM refused that username and password (or the account is locked or expired). Check them by hand: `sudo -n {pamtester} {service} <user> authenticate acct_mgmt`
That is a system or service account (root, a UID below 1000, or a nologin shell). Those never sign in to filex - use a normal account.
That name cannot be a filex username: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore; 3 to 32 characters; starting with a letter.
